text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corporation said it bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No 1 soybean from Daewoo Corp at $321.22 per tonne C&F and another 20,000 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus at $320.80.

BARLEY SALE - Iran has bought 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley at prices ranging from $129 to $129.50 per tonne, FOB, European grain traders said. The barley is for shipment in April. The barley is likely to come from the European Union, Canada and Australia, traders said.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan's Hui Shung Group will tender on Thursday for a combined shipment comprising 38,500 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, local traders said. Shipments were slated for March and April.
WHEAT TENDERS - Korea Flour Milling Corp said on Wednesday it passed on a tender for 15,400 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to high prices.
- The CCC said it was seeking up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 soft white wheat, 13.5 percent moisture, for Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for Feb 20 to March 15.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender February 5 for 2,170 tonnes of No.2 hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, for donation to Uganda. The donation will be made under the World Food Program and will be shipped March 1-25.

- Egypt's main wheat buyer said Tuesday it was seeking bids for 50,000 tonnes of Argentine, U.S. or French wheat for loading in March or April. The deadline for bids is 8 a.m. local (0600 GMT) on Feb 1.
- Results were awaited on Bangladesh's tender for 100,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian or Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by Feb 21, traders said.

WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, for delivery in two lots of hard and soft wheat, an official for the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender, for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, will close on February 7. Several U.S. exporters earlier said the tender would close on February 6.

The soft wheat would be for delivery between February 17-26, if it is of U.S., Canadian, European or Argentine origin and between March 3-12 if it is from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The hard wheat is for delivery from February 10-19 for the first category and March 24-April 2 for second category.

WHEAT TENDERS - Algeria is seeking 150,000 tonnes of durum wheat for shipment between mid-March and the end of April. The Algerian Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales said Algeria would consider durum from the U.S., Canada and Syria. The tender calls for shipments of 50,000 tonnes each for March 16-31, April 1-15 and April 16-30.
- Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month, the government said.
CORN TENDER - News was awaited on South Africa's Maize Board's tender for 15,000 tonnes of yellow maize for either export or domestic use. The offer was seen closing Jan 16.

CORN TENDERS - The CCC said it seeks to buy 27,170 tonnes of No. 2 yellow corn for donation to Uganda, Mozambique and Angola. Offers are due on Feb 5. The CCC said 10,000 tonnes will be donated to Uganda, 9,260 to Mozambique and 7,910 to Angola. Shipment of all three lots was to be March 1-25.

BARLEY TENDERS - Tunisia launched a tender for 100,000 tonnes of any-origin barley for shipment between May and August -- the first from the region to include new-crop positions. The closing date for the tender is Jan 30.
- Turkey will tender Feb 3 to export 150,000 tonnes feed barley and 50,000 tonnes malting barley for Feb/Mar shipment.
SORGHUM TENDERS - The CCC said it would seek 15,000 tonnes of U.S. no 2 or better sorghum, of which 5,000 tonnes would be for donation to Uganda and 10,000 tonnes for Ethiopia.
The CCC said the shipment period for both tenders was March 1-25. Offers for both were due on February 5.
RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organization for Chemicals and Foodstuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be February 3.

- Iraq will tender on Feb 3 for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain rice under Iraq's "food-for-oil" program, U.S. exporters said. The tender is for two 15,000 tonne positions for April and May delivery.
PALM STEARIN TENDER - Egypt's state Food Industries Co said it sought 10,000 tonnes of Malaysian or Indonesian palm stearin for March delivery. The tender will close on Feb 12.

MARKET TALK - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation is considering purchasing 300,000 tonnes of Argentine corn in place of U.S. origin due to the relative price advantage of the South American crop, a senior NLCF official said on Wednesday.
